newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb kills at least 11, wounds 40 in Algiers.
newsitem.headline: Bomb kills at least 11, wounds 40 in Algiers.

text.p: A bomb exploded in a market in Algiers on Monday, killing at least 11 people and wounding 40, Algerian security forces said in a statement.
The bomb went off at around 11.15 a.m. (1015 GMT) in the weekly market in Baraki, a southern suburb of the capital.
"The blast, according to a provisional toll, resulted in the death of 11 people and wounding of around 40 others," said the security services in a statement carried on the official news agency APS.
Rescue services raced to the market to help the victims of what the authorities termed "this criminal act" -- the usual official term for violence carried out by Moslem fundamentalists.
The explosion came one day after Algeria's authorities vowed to enforce security measures in public places which had been decided last month but only loosely implemented.
